name: Chuck roast
definition: beef roasting or braising joint from the chuck (shoulder).

name: Flat iron steak
definition: beef steak cut from the top blade muscle of the chuck.

name: Ribeye steak
definition: beef steak cut from the rib section, bone-in or boneless.

name: Striploin steak
definition: beef steak cut from the short loin (strip loin).

name: Beef tenderloin
definition: the beef tenderloin (fillet), whole or cut into steaks.

name: T-bone steak
definition: bone-in beef steak from the short loin holding both striploin and tenderloin across a T-shaped bone.

name: Top sirloin steak
definition: beef steak cut from the top sirloin (rump side of the loin).

name: Rump cap
definition: the beef rump cap muscle with its fat cap, whole or sliced.

name: Skirt steak
definition: beef steak cut from the diaphragm muscles (outer or inner skirt).

name: Beef short rib
definition: beef rib section cut short across or along the bones.

name: Beef brisket
definition: beef joint from the breast, whole or as point or flat.

name: Beef shin
definition: beef cut from the lower leg, on or off the bone.

name: Beef primal or side
definition: beef sold as a primal (chuck, rib, loin, round, flank, plate, brisket, shank), side or carcass.

name: Ground beef
definition: raw minced beef sold loose or packed.

name: Beef burgers & meatballs
definition: raw minced beef shaped into burgers, meatballs or similar, plain or only seasoned.

name: Beef tongue
definition: the tongue of cattle, sold raw.

name: Sweetbreads
definition: The thymus or pancreas glands of a calf, sold raw.

name: Pork jowl
definition: the cheek and jowl of a pig, sold raw.

name: Pork collar
definition: pork cut from the neck and upper shoulder (collar, Boston butt).

name: Pork loin chop
definition: pork chop cut across the loin, bone-in or boneless.

name: Pork tenderloin
definition: the pork tenderloin (fillet), whole or in medallions.

name: Pork ribs
definition: pork rib sections (spare ribs, baby back ribs), sold raw.

name: Pork belly
definition: raw, uncured pork belly, skin-on or skinless.

name: Pork hock
definition: the lower leg joint of a pig above the trotter, sold raw.

name: Pork trotter
definition: the foot of a pig, sold raw.

name: Suckling pig
definition: a whole milk-fed young pig, sold whole.

name: Ground pork
definition: raw minced pork sold loose or packed.

name: Pork burgers & meatballs
definition: raw minced pork shaped into burgers, meatballs or similar, plain or only seasoned.

name: Lamb rack
definition: the rib section of a lamb with its chops joined, sold raw.

name: Lamb leg
definition: the hind leg of a lamb, whole or part, on or off the bone.

name: Lamb
definition: Lamb or mutton sold whole or as any cut not listed separately.

name: Suckling lamb
definition: a whole milk-fed young lamb, sold whole.

name: Goat
definition: Goat meat sold whole or as any cut not listed separately.

name: Whole chicken
definition: a whole dressed chicken carcass, including poussin and capon.

name: Chicken breast
definition: the breast meat of a chicken, on or off the bone, skin-on or skinless.

name: Chicken leg
definition: the leg of a chicken (thigh and drumstick together or apart).

name: Turkey
definition: Turkey sold whole or as any cut.

name: Duck breast
definition: the breast of a duck, skin-on, sold raw.

name: Whole duck
definition: a whole dressed duck carcass.

name: Foie gras
definition: the enlarged liver of a duck or goose, sold raw.

name: Pheasant
definition: Pheasant sold whole or as any cut.

name: Partridge
definition: Partridge sold whole or as any cut.

name: Venison saddle
definition: the saddle (loin section) of a deer, on or off the bone.

name: Venison medallions
definition: round slices cut from the venison loin.

name: Venison
definition: Venison sold whole or as any cut not listed separately.

name: Rabbit
definition: Rabbit sold whole or as any cut.

name: Hare
definition: Hare sold whole or as any cut.

name: Wild boar
definition: Wild boar sold whole or as any cut.

name: Horse meat
definition: Horse meat sold whole or as any cut, including raw slices for eating raw.

name: Bison
definition: Bison sold whole or as any cut.

name: Frogs' legs
definition: the hind legs of edible frogs, sold raw or frozen.

name: Turtle meat
definition: the meat of turtles sold to eat.

name: Edible insects
definition: Crickets, mealworms and other insects sold to eat, fresh, frozen, dried or roasted.

name: Mixed fresh meats
definition: A pack of raw meats from several animals, none making up half or more of its weight.

name: Dry-cured ham on the bone
definition: the hind leg of a pig, salted and air-dried raw, sold whole or sliced.

name: Guanciale
definition: pork jowl salted and air-dried raw.

name: Coppa
definition: the pork neck (collar) salted and air-dried raw, sold whole or sliced (coppa).

name: Cured pork shoulder
definition: the front leg of a pig salted and air-dried raw (paleta).

name: Cured pork loin
definition: the pork loin salted, seasoned and air-dried raw in a casing or net (lomo).

name: Bacon
definition: cured pork belly, back or loin sold in rashers or a piece to be cooked, smoked or unsmoked.

name: Pancetta
definition: Pork belly salted and air-dried raw, eaten without cooking or used in cooking (not the fresh Spanish panceta).

name: Bresaola
definition: a beef whole muscle salted and air-dried raw.

name: Cooked ham
definition: pork leg cured then cooked, sold whole or sliced, bone-in or boneless, glazed or plain.

name: Pastrami
definition: beef cured, seasoned, smoked and cooked, sold as a piece or sliced.

name: Corned beef
definition: beef brine-cured and cooked, usually brisket, also silverside (salt beef) or another cut, sold as a piece or sliced.

name: Jerky
definition: strips or slabs of meat seasoned and dried, sold to eat as they are.

name: Lardo
definition: pork back fat cured with salt and seasoning, not rendered.

name: Pickled or fermented meat
definition: meat preserved by pickling in vinegar or brine, or by lactic fermentation, outside a sausage casing.

name: Mixed cured meats
definition: A pack of cured meats from several kinds, none making up half or more of its weight.

name: Fresh pork sausage
definition: raw seasoned minced pork in a casing, sold to be cooked.

name: Salami
definition: Fermented, air-dried sausage of chopped meat and fat, eaten without cooking.

name: Chorizo
definition: dry-cured sausage seasoned with paprika.

name: 'Nduja
definition: Soft, spreadable fermented pork sausage with chilli, sold in a casing (a jar of spread is in Pantry Staples).

name: Frankfurter
definition: Thin sausage of finely blended meat, usually smoked, heated or eaten cold.

name: Mortadella
definition: Large sausage of finely blended cooked meat, often with cubes of fat, sold for slicing.

name: Liver sausage
definition: cooked sausage made mainly of liver and meat, sliced or spread from the casing.

name: Mixed sausages
definition: A pack of sausages of several kinds, none making up half or more of its weight.

name: Rotisserie chicken
definition: A whole bird roasted or cooked plain or only seasoned, sold ready to eat.

name: Cooked sliced roast meat
definition: A cut roasted or cooked plain or only seasoned, sold whole or sliced to eat cold (porchetta is listed under its own name).

name: Cooked meatballs & patties
definition: minced meat of one animal shaped and cooked, plain or only seasoned, not coated, filled or sauced.

name: Tinned corned beef
definition: cured, cooked beef sealed and cooked in its tin.

name: Luncheon meat
definition: cured, seasoned minced meat formed into a block and cooked in a sealed tin.

name: Confit
definition: meat (duck, goose, pork) cooked slowly and preserved in its own fat, in a tin, jar or pot.

name: Head cheese
definition: pieces of head meat set in their own jelly, sold as a loaf or slice.

name: Pâté
definition: A cooked, finely or coarsely ground meat mixture sold as a loaf or slice to be cut (a spread in a jar or tub is in Pantry Staples).

name: Terrine
definition: a cooked meat preparation set in a terrine mould, sold whole or sliced (duck, game, poultry terrine).

name: Mixed cooked meats
definition: A pack of cooked meats of several kinds, none making up half or more of its weight.

name: Flank steak
definition: beef steak cut from the flank, the abdominal muscle behind the plate.

name: Tri-tip
definition: triangular beef roast or steak from the bottom sirloin.

name: Rib roast
definition: beef roasting joint from the rib section, bone-in or boneless.

name: Eye of round
definition: lean cylindrical beef roast from the round (hindquarter).

name: Top round
definition: beef roasting joint or steak from the inside of the round.

name: Oxtail
definition: the tail of cattle, sold raw in sections to braise.

name: Beef liver
definition: the liver of cattle, sold raw.

name: Beef heart
definition: the heart of cattle, sold raw.

name: Beef kidney
definition: the kidney of cattle, sold raw.

name: Veal chop
definition: veal chop cut from the rib or loin, bone-in.

name: Veal flank
definition: veal cut from the flank, sold as a steak or to roll.

name: Pork shoulder joint
definition: The front leg and lower shoulder of a pig, or the whole shoulder as one joint; the collar alone is sold as Pork collar.

name: Pork loin joint
definition: Boneless or bone-in pork loin roasting joint; chops cut across it are sold as Pork loin chop.

name: Pork leg
definition: the raw, uncured hind leg of a pig, whole or as a joint.

name: Pork stomach
definition: the stomach of a pig, sold raw.

name: Lamb chops
definition: lamb chops cut from the loin or rib, bone-in.

name: Lamb shoulder
definition: the shoulder of a lamb, whole or part, on or off the bone.

name: Lamb shank
definition: the lower leg of a lamb, sold raw to braise.

name: Chicken wings
definition: the wings of a chicken, whole or as flats and drumettes, sold raw.

name: Duck leg
definition: the leg of a duck, sold raw.

name: Goose
definition: Goose sold whole or as any cut.

name: Quail
definition: Quail sold whole, spatchcocked or boned.

name: Guinea fowl
definition: Guinea fowl sold whole or as any cut.

name: Grouse
definition: Grouse sold whole or as any cut.

name: Wild duck
definition: Wild duck (mallard, teal, wigeon) sold whole or as any cut.

name: Black pudding
definition: cooked sausage made mainly of blood with fat, grain or meat, sliced or heated to eat.

name: Gammon
definition: pork hind leg wet- or dry-cured and sold raw as a joint or steaks to be cooked.

name: Cooked cured tongue
definition: ox or pork tongue brined, cooked and pressed, sold whole or sliced.

name: Hanger steak
definition: beef steak from the hanging tender of the diaphragm (onglet).

name: Wood pigeon
definition: Wood pigeon or squab sold whole or as breasts.

name: Squirrel
definition: squirrel meat sold whole or jointed to eat.

name: Pork primal or side
definition: pork sold as a primal (shoulder, loin, leg, belly), side or carcass.

name: Goat chops
definition: goat chops cut from the rib or loin, bone-in.

name: Goat shank
definition: the lower leg of a goat, sold raw to braise.

name: Goat leg
definition: the hind leg of a goat, whole or part, on or off the bone.

name: Ground goat
definition: raw minced goat meat sold loose or packed.

name: Goat burgers
definition: raw minced goat shaped into burgers or similar, plain or only seasoned.

name: Ground duck
definition: raw minced duck meat sold loose or packed.

name: Venison haunch
definition: the hind leg of a deer, whole or as a roasting joint or steaks, on or off the bone.

name: Venison fillet
definition: the tenderloin of a deer, whole or cut into steaks.

name: Venison rack
definition: the rib section of a deer with its chops joined, sold raw.

name: Ground venison
definition: raw minced venison sold loose or packed.

name: Venison burgers & meatballs
definition: raw minced venison shaped into burgers, meatballs or similar, plain or only seasoned.

name: Rabbit saddle
definition: the loin section of a rabbit, on or off the bone, sold raw.

name: Rabbit leg
definition: the hind or front legs of a rabbit, sold raw.

name: Horse ribeye steak
definition: horse steak cut from the rib section.

name: Horse tenderloin
definition: the tenderloin of a horse, whole or cut into steaks.

name: Horse sirloin steak
definition: horse steak cut from the sirloin (loin).

name: Horse flank steak
definition: horse steak cut from the flank.

name: Ground horse meat
definition: raw minced horse meat sold loose or packed.

name: Kielbasa
definition: Coarse or medium-ground smoked sausage, sold in links or rings to heat or slice.

name: White pudding
definition: cooked sausage of pork, fat and oatmeal or other grain, without blood, sliced or heated to eat.
